UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile with their name, email, and role within the Desa Digital application. Authentication details are handled externally by Firebase Auth.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to the Firebase Auth User ID (UID).

email.description: Email address of the user, used for authentication.

role.description: Role of the user within the application, determining access privileges (e.g., 'admin', 'operator desa').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this user profile record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this user profile record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserProfile)

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserProfile)

BpdMember.title: BpdMember
BpdMember.description: Represents a member of the Village Consultative Body (BPD).

RtRwMember.title: RtRwMember
RtRwMember.description: Represents a member of the RT/RW.

Apbdes.title: Apbdes
Apbdes.description: Represents the Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Desa (APBDes) for a specific fiscal year, including aggregated financial figures.

id.description: Unique identifier for the APBDes entity.

year.description: The fiscal year for which the APBDes applies (e.g., 2023).

village.description: The village this APBDes belongs to.

revenue.description: Total village revenue (pendapatan) for the fiscal year, excluding Dana Desa.

revenueSources.description: A breakdown of revenue by source, excluding Dana Desa. Keys are source names, values are amounts.

expenditure.description: Total village expenditure (belanja) for the fiscal year.

financing.description: Total village financing (pembiayaan) for the fiscal year.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this APBDes record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this APBDes record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Apbdes)

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Apbdes)

ApbdesDetail.title: ApbdesDetail
ApbdesDetail.description: Represents a detailed line item contributing to the aggregated revenues, expenditures, or financing of an APBDes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the APBDes Detail entity.

apbdesId.description: Reference to the parent APBDes entity this detail belongs to. (Relationship: Apbdes 1:N ApbdesDetail)

village.description: The village this APBDes detail belongs to.

year.description: The fiscal year for this APBDes detail.

description.description: A description of the detailed item (e.g., 'Dana Desa', 'Pembangunan Jalan').

amount.description: The monetary amount for this detailed item.

category.description: The category of this detail item (e.g., 'Pendapatan', 'Belanja', 'Pembiayaan'), linking it to the respective APBDes aggregate.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this APBDes Detail record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this APBDes Detail record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ApbdesDetail)

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ApbdesDetail)

JalanDesa.title: JalanDesa
JalanDesa.description: Represents data for a village road, including its condition and dimensions.

JalanKabupaten.title: JalanKabupaten
JalanKabupaten.description: Represents data for a regency road (jalan kabupaten).

village.description: The village this road segment belongs to.

Monev.title: Monev
Monev.description: Represents a record for Monitoring and Evaluation (Monev) of APBDes activities and their realization status. Linked to a specific APBDes detail.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Monev entity.

village.description: The village this Monev record belongs to.

apbdesDetailId.description: Reference ID to the specific ApbdesDetail document this Monev is for.

year.description: The fiscal year to which the Monev activity belongs.

activity.description: Description of the APBDes activity or program being monitored (copied from ApbdesDetail).

apbdesCode.description: The account code for the activity (copied from ApbdesDetail).

fundingSource.description: The funding source for the activity (copied from ApbdesDetail).

budget.description: The allocated budget for the specific activity (copied from ApbdesDetail).

realization.description: The actual realized expenditure or progress for the activity.

notes.description: Optional notes from the admin regarding the evaluation.

volume.description: The volume or output of the activity, e.g., 100 meters, 5 units.

value.description: The numeric or textual value of the volume.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the volume.

tanggalRealisasi.description: The date the activity was realized or completed.

fotoUrl.description: URL to a photo of the activity stored in Google Drive.

Regulation.title: Regulation
Regulation.description: Represents official village regulations, such as Perdes (Peraturan Desa), Perkades (Peraturan Kepala Desa), or SK (Surat Keputusan).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Regulation entity.

number.description: The regulation's official number or code.

date.description: The date when the regulation was issued.

about.description: A brief description or the main subject of the regulation.

fileUrl.description: URL to the PDF file of the regulation stored in Firebase Storage.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this Regulation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this Regulation record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Regulation)

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Regulation)

KpmBlt.title: KpmBlt
KpmBlt.description: Represents a Keluarga Penerima Manfaat (KPM) for BLT-DD (Bantuan Langsung Tunai Dana Desa) program.

id.description: Unique identifier for the KPM BLT-DD entity.

name.description: Full name of the BLT-DD beneficiary.

nik.description: Nomor Induk Kependudukan (NIK) or National ID number of the beneficiary.

period.description: The period for which the BLT-DD beneficiary is registered (e.g., 'Triwulan I 2023', '2023-01').

isActive.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary is currently active in the program.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this KPM BLT-DD record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this KPM BLT-DD record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N KpmBlt)

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N KpmBlt)

PosyanduKader.title: PosyanduKader
PosyanduKader.description: Represents a Kader (volunteer) of a specific Posyandu in a village.

P3keIntervention.title: P3keIntervention
P3keIntervention.description: Represents a P3KE (Pensasaran Percepatan Penghapusan Kemiskinan Ekstrem) intervention record.

id.description: Unique identifier for the P3KE Intervention entity.

village.description: The village where the intervention is implemented.

totalAnggaran.description: The total budget for the intervention (e.g., 'Rp 15.000.000').

sumberAnggaran.description: The funding source for the intervention.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who created this record.

updatedBy.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who last updated this record.

PrioritasDanaDesa.title: PrioritasDanaDesa
PrioritasDanaDesa.description: Represents the priority allocation of the Village Fund (Dana Desa) for a specific year.

SpjDocument.title: SpjDocument
SpjDocument.description: Represents a submitted SPJ document, linking it to a village and storing its Google Drive URL.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Stores global application settings like logo and background URLs.

arsipDriveFolderIds.description: Google Drive Folder IDs for storing archived documents, categorized by field.

UMUM & PELAYANAN.description: Folder ID for UMUM & PELAYANAN documents.

VillageSettings.title: VillageSettings
VillageSettings.description: Stores village-specific settings, like Google Drive folder IDs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VillageSettings, typically the village name in lowercase.

spjDriveFolderId.description: The Google Drive Folder ID for storing SPJ documents for this village.

produkHukumDriveFolderId.description: The Google Drive Folder ID for storing Produk Hukum documents for this village.

ArsipDokumen.title: ArsipDokumen
ArsipDokumen.description: Represents an archived document in the system.

title.description: The title or description of the document.

Masjid.title: Masjid
Masjid.description: Represents a mosque in a village.

Mushola.title: Mushola
Mushola.description: Represents a mushola (prayer room) in a village.

Kependudukan.title: Kependudukan
Kependudukan.description: Represents population data for a village for a specific year.

PbbP2.title: PbbP2
PbbP2.description: Represents a PBB P2 recapitulation for a village in a specific year.

terbayar.description: The total cumulative amount paid for this record. It is updated automatically when a new payment is added to the 'payments' subcollection.

PbbP2Payment.title: PbbP2Payment
PbbP2Payment.description: Represents a single payment installment for a PBB P2 record.

LinmasMember.title: LinmasMember
LinmasMember.description: Represents a member of the Linmas (Community Protection).

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for the Desa Digital application is designed to prioritize authorization independence, clarity, and scalability, aligning with the core design principles. The primary authorization mechanism is **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**, where user roles ('admin' or 'operator desa') are stored in the `/users/{userId}` collection. This strategy enables robust and easily debuggable security rules.

**Authorization Independence:**
1.  **User Role Lookup:** The access rules for all data collections (APBDes, Monev, Regulations, KPM BLT-DD, Posyandu) will rely on a single, self-contained lookup of the requesting user's role from their own `userProfiles` document (`get(/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role`). This approach is critical as it avoids `get()` calls to other *data* documents for authorization, which could otherwise introduce hierarchical dependencies, complicate atomic operations, and make debugging security issues difficult. Since the user's role is an attribute of the *requesting user* themselves, its lookup is not considered a 'hierarchical authorization dependency' in the context of one data entity's access being dependent on another *unrelated* data entity's attributes.
2.  **Global Role-Based Access:** All documents within `apbdes`, `monev`, `regulations`, `kpmBlts`, and `posyandus` collections share the same security posture (e.g., 'admin can CRUD, operator can CUD'). This means access to a subcollection like `/apbdes/{apbdesId}/details/{apbdesDetailId}` does *not* depend on specific attributes of its parent `apbdes` document (e.g., `apbdes.createdBy`). Instead, it depends directly on the requesting user's global role. This eliminates the need to denormalize `ownerId` or `members` maps from parent documents into subcollection documents for authorization purposes in this specific application, as the global role suffices.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
1.  **Structural Segregation:** Each collection (`/apbdes`, `/monev`, `/regulations`, `/kpmBlts`, `/posyandus`) represents a homogeneous set of data, meaning all documents within a given collection have the same access requirements based on user roles. This allows `list` operations to be securely managed by simple role checks in Firestore rules (e.g., `allow list: if isSignedInAndHasRole(['admin', 'operator desa'])`). The client application does not need to perform complex queries (e.g., `where('ownerId', '==', request.auth.uid)`) to enforce security; the rules grant or deny access to the entire collection based on the user's established role, thereby enabling Query-as-Permission (QAPs).
2.  **Predictable Access Patterns:** The consistent role-based access model makes security rules straightforward and predictable, directly mapping user roles to CRUD capabilities across different data types, thus supporting efficient and secure data retrieval via list operations without client-side filtering for authorization.

**Other Principles:**
*   **DBAC:** User roles (`role` field) are stored directly in the `users` collection, fulfilling the Database Access Control principle without relying on custom claims.
*   **Invariants:** All data entities include `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, and `updatedBy` fields to maintain data integrity and audit trails.
*   **Structural Segregation:** Entities with different security postures are housed in separate top-level collections (e.g., `users` for user profiles and `apbdes` for financial data), simplifying rule writing. Nested data, such as `ApbdesDetail`, is stored in subcollections (`/apbdes/{apbdesId}/details`) to allow for scalable storage and independent management of individual detail items, while still benefiting from the overarching role-based authorization.
